verdict.rationale: Stripe Terminal documents its own fleet features: registering readers by serial number, registration code, or order number, and organizing many readers across sites with locations and zones. The locations-and-zones doc has an API variant. However, monitoring and configuration are documented only for the Dashboard, not as API operations. missing for 10: explicit API endpoints for reader registration, remote status monitoring via API, remote configuration updates via API, independent hands-on corroboration of API fleet management.

support.subject: As a developer, I can manage a fleet of readers and terminals via API — register devices, monitor status, and update configuration remotely

citations.quote: You can streamline the management of multiple readers across different physical sites by using locations and zones.
You can register readers using their serial number. This method doesn’t require someone to physically have the reader to register it
Reader management: Order, register, configure, and monitor readers from the Dashboard.
